title: Autocomplete for renaming function to be override places new return type before parameters and return type
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.8.dev.custom_build [74e99170e]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (74e99170e) - macOS Tahoe (26.6.2) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (4608x2592 @ 120.00 Hz, 3840x2160 @ 60.00 Hz) - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When attempting to rename an already-defined function by placing the cursor in between the end of the function's name and the parentheses for its arguments and backspacing then typing, autocomplete suggestions will insert a new set of parentheses and return type instead of overwriting the already-existing ones:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/262c19e1-6bc4-48f3-9ffb-e36783b32e02

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75a99581-7ec4-4e54-9bab-d60d143a67ba

Notably, if the full function name is typed by the user and they press Enter/Return to select the autocompletion option, in the built-in script editor the cursor is simply moved to the end of the line; in external editors (at least VS Code), the incorrect behavior still occurs.

### Steps to reproduce

Add the following code to a new script:
```gdscript
extends Node2D


# Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time.
func _ready() -> void:
	pass
```

Place your cursor at the end of `_ready` and backspace a few times, then start re-typing `_ready`. Make sure you do not type the full `_ready` name. Press Enter/Return to accept the completion `_ready() -> void`, and see that it inserts text so that the file now reads:
```gdscript
extends Node2D


# Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time.
func _ready() -> void:() -> void:
	pass
```
